decision_table.name: Determine_NY_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file NY state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in NY (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
NY filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: NY Tax Law Article 9-A Reference: NY Department of Taxation and Finance Publication 20 Reference: TSB-M-15(1)C - Corporate Tax Reform

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
NY filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $1,000,000 in NY gross receipts.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: NY Tax Law § 209.1 Reference: TSB-M-18(5)C - Economic Nexus Standard
No NY nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_NY_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate NY state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
NY state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Additions may include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations (NY Tax Law § 208.9) - IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback - Certain depreciation adjustments
Subtractions may include: - Interest on NY state and local government bonds - Qualified emerging technology company (QETC) deductions
Reference: NY Form CT-3 Instructions (Article 9-A) Reference: NY Tax Law § 208 (Computation of tax) Reference: TSB-M-18(1)C - Federal Tax Law Changes
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_NY_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate NY state corporate income tax. Applies NY 6.5% tax rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
NY state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to NY: × [Apportionment %] 3. State additions: + [Additions] 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions] 5. NY taxable income: = [Result] 6. NY tax rate: × 6.5% 7. NY income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. NY credits: - [Credits] 9. NY tax liability (before MTA): = [Tax]
Note: MTA surcharge (0.34%) calculated separately if business is in MTA region.
Reference: NY Form CT-3 Instructions (Article 9-A General Business Corporation) Reference: NY Tax Law § 209 (Tax rate: 6.5%) Reference: NY Tax Law § 210 (Computation of tax base) Reference: TSB-M-15(1)C - Corporate Tax Reform
No NY nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
No NY taxable income - no tax liability. NY NOL rules may apply (not implemented).

decision_table.name: Calculate_NY_MTA_Surcharge
decision_table.description: Calculate NY MTA surcharge for businesses in MTA region. Surcharge is 0.34% of business income base.

condition.name: has_positive_tax_base
condition.comment: Has positive tax base for surcharge calculation

rule.policy:
NY MTA surcharge applies to businesses in the MTA region.
MTA Surcharge Calculation: - Business income base: [State taxable income] - MTA surcharge rate: × 0.34% (17/50ths of 1%) - MTA surcharge: = [Surcharge amount] - Total NY tax: Base tax + MTA surcharge
MTA Region includes: - New York City (5 boroughs) - Counties: Dutchess, Nassau, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Suffolk, Westchester
Reference: NY Tax Law § 209-B (MTA surcharge) Reference: NY Form CT-3-M/ATT (MTA Surcharge) Reference: TSB-M-09(1)C - MTA Surcharge Implementation

actions.action: result.ny_mta_surcharge = 0.0; // State tax and refund/owed already calculated in table 50180

rule.policy: No MTA surcharge - business not operating in MTA region.
No MTA surcharge - no NY nexus or no taxable income.
No MTA surcharge - no positive tax base.
